LESSON: MY PURPOSE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation Talents and Abilities
Topic 1.1: My Purpose

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers My Purpose, part of Creation Talents and Abilities in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: how I use my talents and abilities’. How do you use your God-given talents and abilities?
